name: Grillmaster
description: A cheerful suburban dad in his mid fifties, a man who runs the backyard grill like a yacht-rock bandleader and sings smooth yacht rock.
build: A solid dad build of ordinary height: broad soft shoulders, a rounded belly under the apron, sturdy arms and legs of ordinary length, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Light tan sun-reddened skin, blue-grey eyes under thick sandy-grey brows, a straight nose, full cheeks, a thick sandy-grey moustache, and thin lips.
hair: Short sandy-grey hair cut close at the sides, showing below the visor band and over the ears.
outfit: A bright white sun visor with a wide flat navy bill over the forehead; a short-sleeved coral-red camp shirt with a wide open collar; over it a full-length navy canvas bib apron, from chest to knee, tied at the waist, with KISS THE COOK in large bold white block letters across the chest; khaki cargo shorts to the knee; white crew socks and white canvas sneakers with thick soles. Both forearms and hands are bare.
performance_style: Planted and proud: feet shoulder-width apart, belly forward, weight back on the heels. Both arms hang loosely at his sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, fingers spread and visible. Head level, a broad satisfied grin.
location: A sunny suburban backyard at late afternoon: a trimmed green lawn running to the bottom of the frame, a black kettle grill with a thin trail of grey smoke at one side, a cedar fence behind, a red-and-white checked picnic table, and a string of bulb lights looping overhead.
recognition_cues: a navy bib apron with KISS THE COOK in bold white letters
a white visor with a navy bill
a coral-red camp shirt and a sandy-grey moustache
palette: visor bill and apron navy canvas #1F3358 / #111D33 / #3A5585
avoid: grill tongs or a spatula on the key art
a baseball cap instead of the visor

sing.intent: Yacht-rock vocal loop: sway the belly side to side, bring the mic in the character-right hand to the mouth, roll the character-left hand in a lazy circle at chest height, then return to the planted stance. The mouth visibly opens and changes shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A startled hop back from a flare-up of the grill he cannot see: shoulders jump, both open hands rise to chest height, then he settles back to the planted stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: widen the feet and hold both open hands out palm-forward at chest height like shielding the grill, then hold a steady finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: stride in with a proud belly-first walk, stop square to the front and plant both sneakers, both open hands at his sides.
